## Read a union dataset 
```{r}
union_expression <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/expr_tes_all_counts_not_filtered.csv", sep=",", header=T)
rownames(union_expression) <- union_expression$X
# read tes to exclude 
tes_to_exclude <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/te_filtering_overlap/filtered_atleast1bp_overalp_with_gene_id_list.csv", sep=",", header=F)

# Filter input dataset
union_expression_filtered <- union_expression[!union_expression$X %in% tes_to_exclude$V1, ]

tes_activated <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/gwas_set_all_plates_ds_controls/blups_gwas/tes_up_col0_sel2.csv")

filtered_df <- union_expression_filtered[rownames(union_expression_filtered) %in% tes_activated$gene, ]
names <- row.names(filtered_df)



## Get TEs which are belong to the certain histone mark 
histone_marks<- read.csv("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/data_from_pierre/histone_stages/chromatine_stages_araport11tes.csv", sep=",") 
union_expression_filtered_histone_marks <- union_expression[union_expression_filtered$X %in% histone_marks$gene_id, ]

## Read heritability results
high_heritable_with_families2 <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/gwas_set_all_plates_ds_controls/blups_gwas/log2_mean_centered_col0def_270acc_f1ddm1/individual_te_excluded_mismatches/heritability_tesmorehtan02.csv")
high_heritable_with_families2 <- high_heritable_with_families2 %>% select(TE_id,heritability, Super.Family)
high_heritable_with_families2 <- unique(high_heritable_with_families2)
## Add families
high_heritable_with_families2 <- inner_join(high_heritable_with_families2,histone_marks, by=c("TE_id"="gene_id"))
union_expression_filtered_histone_marks_fam <- inner_join(union_expression_filtered_histone_marks,high_heritable_with_families2, by=c("X"="TE_id"))


## Dominant states per families
ggplot(high_heritable_with_families2, 
       aes(x = Super.Family, fill = dominant_state)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Super Family",
       y = "Proportion",
       fill = "Dominant State",
       title = "Distribution of dominant states across TE super families") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

## Get only highly heritable TEs 
union_expression_filtered_histone_marks_fam <- union_expression_filtered_histone_marks_fam[union_expression_filtered_histone_marks_fam$heritability>0.4,]
union_expression_filtered_histone_marks_fam$heritability <- NULL
union_expression_filtered_histone_marks_fam$Super.Family <- NULL
union_expression_filtered_histone_marks_fam$dominant_state <- NULL
union_expression_filtered_histone_marks_fam$coverage_percent <- NULL
```

```{r}
filtered_df$X<-NULL

min_val <-0
max_val <- 7

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(min_val, (min_val + max_val)/2, max_val),  # min, mid, max
  c("blue", "white", "red")                    # colors for min, mid, max
)

# Combine the two vectors of column names
selected_patterns <- c('F1_Col_6909', 'F1_ddm1_6909', 'ddm1_ct', 'ct_col')

# Find columns that contain any of the patterns
cols_to_keep <- grep(paste(selected_patterns, collapse = "|"), colnames(filtered_df), value = TRUE)

# Subset the data frame
filtered_df_sample <- filtered_df[, cols_to_keep]


Heatmap(
  as.matrix(filtered_df_sample),
  name = "log2(counts)",
  col = col_fun,  # <-- set your color function here
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
  row_km = 2,
  row_km_repeats = 10,  # (you probably want 10, not 1000)
  column_km = 2,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), 
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13), 
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13)
  )
)

```
## Get clusters
```{r}
union_expression_filtered$X <- NULL
ht <- Heatmap(union_expression_filtered, 
        name = "log2(counts)",
        cluster_columns = TRUE,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        show_row_names = FALSE,
        show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
        row_km = 3,
        row_km_repeats = 1000,
        column_km = 2,
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15), 
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15),
        heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13), 
                                    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13))
)

# Draw the heatmap
ht_drawn <- draw(ht)

# Extract column clusters
column_clusters <- column_order(ht_drawn)


# Create a data frame to store sample-cluster mapping
sample_cluster_df <- data.frame(Sample = character(), 
                               Cluster = integer(),
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Populate the data frame
for (i in 1:length(column_clusters)) {
    cluster_indices <- column_clusters[[i]]
    samples <- colnames(union_expression_filtered)[cluster_indices]
    
    # Add each sample with its cluster number to the data frame
    temp_df <- data.frame(Sample = samples,
                         Cluster = rep(i, length(samples)),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    sample_cluster_df <- rbind(sample_cluster_df, temp_df)
}

# Print the resulting table
print(sample_cluster_df)
```
